steps.name: Regenerate and validate documentation
steps.run: revision=$(python -c "import json;print(json.load(open('docs/metadata/documentation-manifest.json'))['revision'])") echo "Regenerating as of the documented revision ${revision}" make docs REVISION="${revision}"

steps.name: Fail if regeneration changed tracked files
steps.run: if ! git diff --quiet -- docs/; then echo "Generated documentation is out of date. Run 'make docs' and commit the result." git diff --stat -- docs/ exit 1 fi

steps.name: Validate citation metadata
steps.run: poetry run python -c "from pathlib import Path; import yaml; yaml.safe_load(Path('CITATION.cff').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))"

environment_template.name: FEEDBACK_AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER
environment_template.comment: LLM provider: local (default, no API key), openai, openai_responses, anthropic, bedrock, or ollama.

environment_template.name: AWS_REGION
environment_template.comment: AWS Bedrock provider (FEEDBACK_AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER=bedrock, requires the 'bedrock' extra). Credentials are resolved by the AWS SDK chain (env, profile, SSO, IAM role).

environment_template.name: FEEDBACK_AGENT_LLM_RESILIENCE_ENABLED
environment_template.comment: Remote LLM resilience wrapper (not applied to FEEDBACK_AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER=local).

environment_template.name: FEEDBACK_AGENT_HALLUCINATION_JUDGE_ENABLED
environment_template.comment: Optional semantic hallucination review. When true, the configured LLM provider is also used as a judge after deterministic evidence-overlap checks.

environment_template.name: OLLAMA_BASE_URL
environment_template.comment: Ollama provider (FEEDBACK_AGENT_LLM_PROVIDER=ollama, local server, no API key).

environment_template.name: FEEDBACK_AGENT_API_AUTH_ENABLED
environment_template.comment: Optional API-key authorization. Health and readiness remain open.

environment_template.name: FEEDBACK_AGENT_API_RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED
environment_template.comment: Optional in-process fixed-window rate limiting for deployed API instances.

environment_template.name: FEEDBACK_AGENT_TELEMETRY_ENABLED
environment_template.comment: Telemetry is disabled by default. Use backend=jsonl for local event logs or backend=opentelemetry with the optional 'otel' extra and a configured OTel SDK/exporter.

environment_template.name: FEEDBACK_AGENT_CORS_ALLOW_ORIGINS
environment_template.comment: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API (CORS). Use "*" to allow any origin for local demos, or leave empty to disable CORS.
